label: Production Graphic Designer
summary: Two Designing Resumes against Data Science and Digital Media.
job_description:
We are hiring a Production Graphic Designer to turn campaign concepts into finished assets across web, social and print, at the volume a busy calendar needs.

What we need:
- 3-4+ years production design experience
- Advanced Adobe Illustrator
- Adobe Photoshop expertise

The original posting also asked for the following, which this demo does not gate on: Prepare production-ready print files; Understanding of bleeds, color modes, resolution; High-volume fast-turnaround environment; Strong English communication; Independent problem-solving; Workflow Management.
